office: the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' Passport Department

routes.label: expedited services: within 36 – 48 hours, BSD 300 more

note: The fees and times the Passport Department publishes on its online renewal page; whether a first-time application in person costs the same is a lead, as is validity. Since 1 November 2024 a passport collected outside The Bahamas carries a subsidized courier fee of BSD 35. The expedite fee is read as added to the processing fee ('Expedited services'), which the page doesn't state outright.

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of The Bahamas (mofa.gov.bs), ePassport Online Renewal Services
sources.said: PASSPORT FEES 1.Application Processing Fees: $25.00 for minors (under 15 years) $50.00 for adults (15 years and older) NOTICE: As of 1st November, 2024 , a subsidized courier fee of $35.00 will be applied to applicants picking up their passports at locations outside of The Bahamas. 2. Expedited services $300.00 – Within 36 – 48 hrs Expedited fees only apply to passport processing time. ... The Passport Department commits itself, under normal conditions, to the production of a passport (renewal) as listed. Under no circumstance does the Passport Department guarantee or control Courier Delivery timeframes. Category Standard Service Expedite Service Children 7 – 10 Business Days 36 – 48 hours Adults 7 – 10 Business Days 36 – 48 hours
